item.title: Event Handling: Real-time Capture and Production Consumer Architecture
item.description: A detailed guide to ADK Go streaming event handling, covering the event type system, serialization, consumer chains, backpressure, ordered delivery, error recovery, metrics, and production-grade pipelines.

item.title: Multimodal Streaming: Audio, Image, and Video Processing
item.description: A practical guide to ADK Go multimodal streaming, including audio, image, and video input, chunked uploads, progressive decoding, real-time synchronization, and production-ready media pipelines.

item.title: Streaming Chat UI: From SSE to WebSocket for Real-time Interaction
item.description: A production-oriented guide to ADK Go streaming chat interfaces, including SSE and WebSocket selection, reliable message delivery, connection management, frontend incremental rendering, and deployment strategies.

item.title: Streaming Principles and Event Model: Core Technology for Real-time Output
item.description: A deep dive into ADK Go streaming fundamentals: HTTP/2 multiplexing, SSE protocol details, buffer management and backpressure, connection lifecycle management, and production performance optimization and architecture design.
